reviewed_by: Static review: retail objdump/radare2 disassembly for ABI, ownership, return value and callers; Binary Ninja and Radare2 CFG artifacts; nm -C candidate symbol table.

runtime_contract.note: The live differential compares the calls that naturally happened, with the argument words and the result of each call. A pointer value from one process is not the data of the other, so a non-scalar argument is compared as the word it was, and the report says which scope it used.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 both identify a single retail function entry at 0x004CF080 (recorded CFG similarity 1.000); the candidate implementation bound to this address is the free function named by the catalog, and nm -C shows exactly one candidate symbol whose base name matches the catalog name.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The chunk tag constants, the node offsets and the record sizes are the literal values the retail instructions compare and read.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail 0x004CF080 reads cdecl arg1 at [esp+0x124] (context), arg2 at [esp+0x12c] (package name) and arg3 at [esp+0x130] (texture-load flag); its only caller pushes (context, name, 1) at 0x004CF02B-0x004CF02F. The callee owns no context buffer: the caller allocates the 0x4C-byte context at 0x004CEFA9 and the callee fills +0x08, +0x0C, +0x10, +0x1C, +0x28, +0x34, +0x38, +0x3C and +0x44, allocating instance records with Mem_Alloc((mat_count << 3) + 0x1C) and linking them through 0x004AF8F0. The return value is unused by that caller (it returns its own context). The free function igi::retail::dynobj::DynObj_LoadModelTexturePackage(void*, char const*, int) keeps that ABI and ownership; the std::span member that returned MtpPackage by value did not, and its name was removed from the candidate. It is the sole candidate symbol for this catalog name (nm -C).

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The candidate performs the retail's sibling and child walk and returns the retail's null or payload pointer; it has no other side effect.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The candidate reads the retail data as it is stored; it performs no float arithmetic.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The chunk node layout and the payload offsets are the ones the retail instructions read, and the port reads the same fields.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: The candidate follows the retail return paths for this entry; for 0x004CF390 the returned heap record and the incompatible-version Debug_Error branch match retail 0x004CF401-0x004CF422, and for 0x004CF080 the callee's unused leftover return value is not treated as an output by the caller.
